title: Celeste Classic 2 GBA
description:
A port of Celeste Classic 2, the PICO-8 platformer made by Maddy Thorson, Noel Berry and Lena Raine for Celeste's third anniversary. The port aims to be as accurate as possible to the original: gameplay is the same, with some very minor graphical changes, and the PICO-8 audio was converted to tracker files for maxmod. It was tested on emulators, real GBA hardware and the 3DS Virtual Console.

Controls: D-pad moves, A or L jumps, B or R grapples, SELECT pauses. Hold L+R+Down+B and press START to reset the game.
